summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), May 2026. Built applied AI systems spanning computer vision, video analysis, and robotics-inspired logic — from YOLO-based visual servoing on Jetson to image-processing pipelines for surface inspection and autonomous driving simulation.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation; achieved ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Developed custom image-stitching pipeline using bit manipulation and averaging, achieving PSNR of 86 vs. homography baseline on high-resolution visual data.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT visual document transformer on a custom dataset in PyTorch; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8 on a custom detection dataset, improving classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5%; deployed in a consumer mobile app.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI-based real-time chroma keying without a green screen; developed gesture-recognition glove translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python and ADXL345 accelerometers.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency via a distributed pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller.
Integrated TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping; resolved 11 integration failures across servo, detection, and depth subsystems.
Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s) and Gemini intent classification (<500ms) into a unified WebSocket control fabric.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Achieved zero collisions with correct traffic-light compliance across multiple laps (Town02, 30 vehicles, 10 pedestrians); trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD with SoftmaxFocalLoss + ParsingRelationLoss.
Built automated data pipelines using CARLA semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to generate ~8,000 annotated training frames with zero manual labeling.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object detection and tracking; implemented FreeRTOS task scheduling with mutexes and VL53L0X ToF sensing for distance-aware servo control.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Executed collision-free pick-and-place on physical UR5e via ROS 2 driver (AL5B repeatability <2mm); derived full DH kinematic chains for both arms and validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
